headline: Francis Marion and UNC Pembroke both lose away
dek: North Georgia ended the run Francis Marion had been on since their October defeat by UNC Pembroke, and on the same day Columbus State became the first side from outside the conference to beat UNC Pembroke. Francis Marion's sixteen wins are still more than any other programme has managed.
displaced_by: North Georgia beat Francis Marion on 2026-11-15, so the standing headline's unbeaten run no longer holds; the same day Columbus State handed UNC Pembroke its first defeat outside the conference.
